name: inprocess-obi-apb-timer-rvfi-intr-witness-f5
description: One CV32E20 RVFI OBI CPU whose model exports the architectural rvfi_intr retirement flag but no pre-edge take probe, and one declared 25 MHz PULP APB3 timer.  F5 is admitted by the retirement witness and the host counts the handler entry from the CPU's own rvfi_intr record while the device's interrupt level is asserted; no take is inferred from a bus access.
notes: The CPU model exports rvfi_valid/order/insn/pc_rdata plus rvfi_intr, but no probe_irq_taken_pre and no custom EOI.  The entry's cpu_irq_take_witness therefore selects rvfi_intr, and the host increments irq_takes on a valid retirement whose rvfi_intr is set while the host really has the interrupt level asserted (irq_delivered).
A synchronous exception also sets rvfi_intr; the irq_delivered gate is what keeps that from being counted as an interrupt take.

The target is the declared 25 MHz composition variant beside the 50 MHz reference CPU (ratio 2), so the run is also the per-model divider evidence with an IRQ link whose level is sampled every host tick.
